decisions.statement: Every music package is reached through akasha rather than through `collections/`.
A live music call reads its pacing gap at the call rather than once at load.
Everything music keeps is a page in akasha.
No music is kept in markdown.
Every play Alan finishes is filed onto the day of that play.
Every kind of thing music keeps has a page type of its own.
Music keeps the songs made apart from the plays heard.

definition: music heard and what is kept of it
